threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest tube instead of knowing the bus routes. It's all about the bus here, mate.
Caught a guy dancing in the aisle on the 63 last night, completely oblivious to the stares. Ah, Peckham on a Saturday.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw an old lady feeding pigeons while debating politics with a street artist. Only in Neukölln do arguments feel like community events.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find currywurst trucks and art galleries side by side, soaking up street art while grabbing a bite at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a tourist when they stop to gawk at the murals but locals know to keep moving—painted walls won’t save you from a BART delay.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 14 Mission arguing with a pigeon over a discarded burrito. The bird won. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just one big party, but they miss the quiet afternoons when locals sip vermut and catch up at the plaza.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they stand in the middle of the street, staring at their phone maps, completely oblivious to the flow of pedestrians.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep staring blankly at the Tube map, waiting for the next train to arrive like it’s a bus stop. It's a tell-tale sign.
Saw a bloke on the 77 last night trying to convince a busker to join him for a pint. The busker just kept playing 'Wonderwall', completely ignoring him.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw an old lady feeding pigeons while a DJ set up for a block party, I knew this place had its own heartbeat. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you'll find old war bunkers turned into nightclubs. Dancing in a place that once sheltered from bombs feels uniquely Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only true locals know to avoid BART on Fridays after 5 PM. That train's a rolling disaster, and the bus isn't much better.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last night, I saw a bus driver give a rider their personal umbrella during a downpour. Just another Muni moment that shows the spirit of this city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars close by 2 AM, but locals know the real fun starts when the crowds thin out. It’s when the secret spots shine.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a newcomer by their hesitation at ordering 'café con leche'—they still say 'flat white' too loud.
